adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now computes `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `.find(...)` branch runs), the predicate compares `cal.externalId` to `undefined/null`, so it will not match a real destination calendar externalId and returns `undefined`. This regresses the prior fallback (`event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and can lead to using an undefined/primary calendarId and failing to update/delete events for older references without `externalCalendarId`. The same dead lookup pattern exists in `deleteEvent` (`calendarId` computation).
